shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated ornament or pattern
raised arms/hands and hands holding or presenting objects
division of the surface into stacked registers or zones
vertical linear elements (staff/pole-like or ribbed motifs)
justification: Both are shallow relief on light tan stone and both include a horizontal band of repeated small motifs beneath or between figural zones, with profile figures whose arms/hands are prominent. But A stacks small, flat, schematic animals and abstract signs in several superimposed registers on a narrow pillar, while B is a single wide frieze of large, anatomically modelled human figures with fine internal detail (garments, hair, musculature), so the compositional scheme and carving manner differ fundamentally.
